title: International Seaways to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results on August 10, 2026
summary: International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company” or “INSW”) announced today that it plans to release second quarter 2026 results before market open on Monday, August 10, 2026. The Company will host a conference call for investors at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time (“ET”) on the same day. Conference Call Details: Date: Monday, August 10, 2026 Time 9:00 AM ET Dial-in Numbers United States: +1 (833) 461-5787 International: +1 (646) 884-3620 Conference ID 832 929 801 A live webcast of the conference call will be available from the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://www.intlseas.com/ . Following the conclusion of the call, an audio replay will be available on the Events page of the Company’s website at www.intlseas.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations until August 7, 2027.
